title: a python/heredoc file write in Bash bypasses the phase writable gate (scope.md edited in planning)
detail: During sprint-drive planning, a python3 heredoc doing open(p,'w') on design/sprint-drive/scope.md succeeded although planning's writable list excludes scope.md. The gate parses shell redirect targets, not interpreter file writes. Reverted by hand. Known class? (bash reader backlog)
